mapper.select:
/* BoardDao.selectBoardList */ SELECT b.BOARD_NO AS board_no, b.TYPE AS board_type, b.TITLE AS title, b.WRITER_EMPNO AS writer, b.POST_DT AS post_date, b.WRITER_EMPNO AS writer_nm, b.POST_DT AS reg_date, b.VIEW_CNT AS view_cnt
ORDER BY b.POST_DT DESC, b.BOARD_NO DESC

/* BoardDao.selectBoardDetail */ SELECT b.BOARD_NO AS board_no, b.TYPE AS board_type, b.TITLE AS title, b.CONTENT AS detail, b.APPND_FILE_GROP_UUID AS append_file_group_uuid, b.POST_DT AS post_date, b.WRITER_EMPNO AS writer_emp_no, b.WRITER_EMPNO AS writer, b.VIEW_CNT AS view_count FROM AP_BOARD b WHERE b.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND b.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* BoardDao.selectAppndFileList */ SELECT f.APPND_FILE_UUID AS appnd_file_uuid, f.APPND_FILE_GROP_UUID AS appnd_file_group_uuid, f.APPND_FILE_PATH_CNTS AS file_path, f.APPND_FILE_ORIG_NM AS original_name, f.APPND_FILE_TRANSMS_NM AS saved_name, f.APPND_FILE_FLEXT_NM AS extension, f.APPND_FILE_MIME_CNTS AS mime_type, f.APPND_FILE_SIZ AS file_size, f.APPND_FILE_PARM_NM AS param_name, f.SRT_ORD AS sort_order, f.DWNLD_COUNT AS download_count FROM ap_appnd_file_mgmt f WHERE f.APPND_FILE_GROP_UUID = #{appndFileGroupUuid} AND IFNULL(f.APPND_FILE_DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY f.SRT_ORD ASC, f.APPND_FILE_UUID ASC
mapper.insert: /* BoardDao.insertBoard */ INSERT INTO AP_BOARD ( TYPE, TITLE, CONTENT, APPND_FILE_GROP_UUID, POST_DT, WRITER_EMPNO, USE_YN, INP_DDTM, INPR_EMPNO, INPR_IP, UPDT_DDTM, UPDTR_EMPNO, UPDTR_IP ) VALUES ( #{boardType}, #{title}, #{detail}, #{appendFileGroupUuid}, #{postDate}, #{writerEmpNo}, 'Y', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), #{userNo}, #{clientIp}, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), #{userNo}, #{clientIp} )

/* BoardDao.insertAppndFile.selectSrtOrd */ SELECT IFNULL(MAX(SRT_ORD), 0) + 1 FROM ap_appnd_file_mgmt WHERE APPND_FILE_GROP_UUID = #{appndFileGropUuid}
/* BoardDao.insertAppndFile */ INSERT INTO ap_appnd_file_mgmt ( APPND_FILE_UUID, APPND_FILE_BASS_CNTS, APPND_FILE_GROP_UUID, APPND_FILE_PATH_CNTS, APPND_FILE_ORIG_NM, APPND_FILE_TRANSMS_NM, APPND_FILE_FLEXT_NM, APPND_FILE_MIME_CNTS, APPND_FILE_SIZ, APPND_FILE_PARM_NM, APPND_FILE_TMP_YN, APPND_FILE_DEL_YN, APPND_FILE_DRM_YN, SRT_ORD, DWNLD_COUNT, INP_DDTM, INPR_EMPNO, INPR_IP, UPDT_DDTM, UPDTR_EMPNO, UPDTR_IP ) VALUES ( #{appndFileUuid}, #{appndFileBassCnts}, #{appndFileGropUuid}, #{appndFilePathCnts}, #{appndFileOrigNm}, #{appndFileTransmsNm}, #{appndFileFlextNm}, #{appndFileMimeCnts}, #{appndFileSiz}, #{appndFileParmNm}, 'N', 'N', 'N', #{srtOrd}, 0, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), #{userNo}, #{clientIp}, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), #{userNo}, #{clientIp} )
mapper.update: /* BoardDao.updateBoard */ UPDATE AP_BOARD SET TYPE = #{boardType}, TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{detail}, APPND_FILE_GROP_UUID = #{appendFileGroupUuid}, POST_DT = #{postDate}, WRITER_EMPNO = #{writerEmpNo}, UPDT_DDTM = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), UPDTR_EMPNO = #{userNo}, UPDTR_IP = #{clientIp} WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
